product.title: Napa Valley Wine Trolley Classic Tour

description.text: Make exploring Wine Country easy on this tour aboard the Napa Valley Wine Trolley. The open-air cable car replica offers vineyard views as you travel to three or four wineries for tastings at your own expense. A guide shares Napa history while lunch at a winery is included for convenience.

highlights: Open-air San Francisco cable car replica through Napa Valley
Visit three or four wineries with reserved tasting stops
Included lunch at a local winery
Pickup and drop-off at Oxbow Public Market in Napa
Guide commentary on Napa Valley wine history

start.description: Meet at Oxbow Public Market, 610 1st St, Napa, CA 94559 at the south parking lot across from the market.

end.description: Return to Oxbow Public Market after the final winery stop.
